description: Shared late enforcement vectors. Every SDK runs each case through its handler: sign event with the vector secret at now, serve exchanges in order (the NoResponse API at api_base_url and the provider's admin API) and fail on any other request, have getAccountState return state (null: unknown), and compare the result's skipped and enforcements, and the error when one is raised. A request matches when its method, its URL with the query compared as an unordered set of decoded pairs, and its JSON body (when given) are equal. Response bodies are JSON.

cases.name: clerk_active_block_restricts_and_revokes
cases.description: An active account whose login decision is block is banned (restrict) and every active session is revoked, across two pages of sessions; each action is recorded at the risk_version read.

cases.name: clerk_onboarding_review_fails_onboarding
cases.description: An onboarding account is judged on its account_creation decision as read from GET, not the stale decision in the event: review fails onboarding and revokes sessions.

cases.name: workos_provisional_block_rejects_activation
cases.description: WorkOS has no ban, so rejecting activation writes noresponse_state to the user's metadata (never a delete) and revokes each active session, following the list cursor.

cases.name: workos_restricted_allow_reinstates_when_opted_in
cases.description: With reinstate on for login, a restricted account whose login decision fell to allow is unrestricted: the metadata key is removed.

cases.name: clerk_restricted_allow_stays_restricted_by_default
cases.description: Reinstatement is opt-in: without it a restricted account stays restricted when its risk falls, and nothing is called or recorded. It is recorded as none, so the account leaves the unenforced feed.

cases.name: auth0_active_block_restricts_and_revokes
cases.description: On a plan with the sessions API, restrict sets blocked: true and revoke deletes every session and refresh token. The user id is percent-encoded in the path.

cases.name: auth0_revoke_falls_back_without_the_sessions_api
cases.description: Review on an active account only revokes sessions. Without Auth0's Enterprise sessions API both session endpoints answer 403 feature_not_enabled: the table's fallback blocks the user to end the login session and deletes each refresh token through /device-credentials, and the block is reported as restrict beside revoke_sessions so the customer knows the account is now restricted.

body.message: This feature is not enabled for this tenant.
This feature is not enabled for this tenant.

cases.name: auth0_refusal_is_recorded_as_failed
cases.description: A refusal that is not a plan limit fails the action: it is recorded as failed with the provider's code, later actions are not attempted, and the handler raises so the delivery is retried.

body.message: Insufficient scope, expected any of: update:users

cases.name: auth0_rate_limit_is_waited_out_and_404_counts_as_done
cases.description: A 429 is retried after Retry-After, and a 404 means the session is already gone, so the action counts as done.

cases.name: replayed_event_changes_nothing
cases.description: A replayed or older event: the customer already enforced the account's current risk_version, so nothing is called or recorded.

cases.name: event_decision_is_ignored
cases.description: The event is only a trigger: it says block, but the account read now says allow, so an active account is left alone. Allow needs nothing for an active account, so none is recorded.

cases.name: erased_account_is_left_alone
cases.description: An account GET answers 404 for was erased: the handler takes no action and does not ask for its state.

cases.name: unknown_user_is_left_alone
cases.description: getAccountState returns nothing for an account the customer does not hold: no action.

cases.name: restricted_account_records_none
cases.description: An account already restricted needs nothing more when its decision stays adverse; the decision is recorded as none so it leaves the unenforced list.

cases.name: step_up_records_none
cases.description: step_up on an active account calls for no provider action; it is recorded as none.

cases.name: rejected_account_records_none
cases.description: A rejected account is final: no provider call, recorded as none.

cases.name: test_event_is_not_actionable
cases.description: Only account.risk_changed is actionable. A test event (or any other type) reads nothing and acts on nothing.

cases.name: clerk_server_error_fails_and_user_id_defaults_to_account
cases.description: Without a user id the account id is the provider user id. A 5xx fails the action with Clerk's error code.

cases.name: auth0_restricted_allow_unblocks_when_opted_in
cases.description: With reinstate on for login, a restricted Auth0 user whose login decision fell to allow is unblocked.

cases.name: clerk_restricted_allow_unbans_when_opted_in
cases.description: With reinstate on for login, a restricted Clerk user whose login decision fell to allow is unbanned. Reinstating account_creation alone does not.

cases.name: clerk_held_provisional_allow_activates
cases.description: A held signup kept provisional settles at account_creation allow: activate is recorded at the risk_version read, so the account leaves the unenforced feed, and Clerk is not called (no provider holds a provisional state).

cases.name: auth0_held_onboarding_allow_activates
cases.description: A held signup kept onboarding settles at account_creation allow: activate is recorded and Auth0 is not called.

cases.name: held_decision_records_none
cases.description: While account_creation is held the account waits: no provider action, recorded as none.

cases.name: held_login_settles_allow_active_records_none
cases.description: A held login settles at allow for an account that is already active: no state changes, and none is recorded at the risk_version read, so the hold is resolved and the account leaves the unenforced feed.
